note: The animal IS a sphere of transposability yet refuses any going-along-with; grasped only once we know what world is.
Roux's definition of the organism as a complex of instruments 'must certainly collapse altogether'.
Roux defined the organism as a complex of instruments / a complicated instrument (Entwickelungsmechanik); footnote bibliography.
'organ' from Greek organon ('instrument'); Greek ergon = German Werk; the organ is a Werkzeug — which Heidegger then contests.
Against von Uexkuell ('most perceptive of contemporary biologists') describing the machine as an 'imperfect organism'.
'Possessing eyes and being able to see are not the same'; the potentiality for seeing first makes eyes possible.
The pen is ready for writing but not capable of writing; readiness ≠ capacity, a fundamentally different manner of being.
Not the organ that has a capacity but the organism; the capability procures organs for itself — organs grow from / end with it.
The organ subserves the capacity that develops it; 'serviceability and subservience are not the same'.
Finished equipment is serviceable-for and lies outside its act ('the being of the hammer is not an urge toward hammering').
Mouth-then-intestine sequence proves capacities prior to organs; organ and equipment relate to time in fundamentally different ways.
Theoretische Biologie (1928), p.98: 'an aperture which first becomes a mouth, then a stomach...' (footnote).
The capable is intrinsically regulative, drives itself toward its wherefore; capacity only where there is drive.
Drives permeate the whole movement in advance, so never merely mechanical; no mathematical expression possible.
Photographed retinal image (window, letter R, church tower) cannot tell us what the glow-worm sees: achievement ≠ capacity.
Capacity becomes proper to itself without self-consciousness/reflection; 'self' reserved for the human, animal's mode = Eigentum.
Pre-argumentative seeing 'radicalized through Husserl' — phenomenology's decisive trait — is the method for grasping proper being.

Organism is neither complex of instruments, union of organs, nor bundle of capacities: a manner of being = proper peculiarity creating organs.
'The animal is organized' = it is rendered capable (befaehigt); being-capable belongs to the animal's being-actual.
The self-driven world-poor organism is the structural background to captivation, the contrast term for boredom-disclosed Dasein.
Organ-achievement does not yield the capacity — models the pipeline's refusal to read an attunement off any one physiological proxy.
